entries.title: Example entry: a thread left open
entries.excerpt: Entries with `- **Status:** open` are pulled to the top of `vault/INDEX.md`, so the loose threads from the paper notebook stay visible.

entries.title: Example entry: how a notebook page gets logged
entries.excerpt: This entry exists so the index has something to chew on. Delete it once real pages are logged.

entries.title: Page numbering
entries.excerpt: Number **every writable side**, straight through, starting at 1. 70 sheets runs to roughly p.140. Same corner every time, in pen, before you write on the page —

entries.title: What an entry needs
entries.excerpt: - **Notebook:** `RS-01 p.12-14` — the book and the side(s). - **Status:** `open` for a thread you mean to come back to.
